;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria]]
**After meeting with [[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]], [[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] says [[Turkey]] has agreed to a five-day ceasefire in [[Syria]] while the United States helps facilitate the withdrawal of [[Kurds|Kurdish]] fighters. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/pence-arrives-in-turkey-as-us-seeks-to-halt-erdogans-syria-offensive/2019/10/17/55b806aa-f04c-11e9-bb7e-d2026ee0c199_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] 

;Disasters and accidents
*The number of people confirmed killed in central and eastern [[Japan]] by [[Typhoon Hagibis (2019)|Typhoon Hagibis]] rises to 77, while nine other people are still missing. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/special/01/1919/ (NHK World)] 
*A [[Peninsula Air]] passenger plane carrying 42 people [[penAir#Accidents and incidents|crashes]] at an airport in [[Unalaska]], [[Alaska]]. One passenger on the [[Saab SB20]] is killed, and at least one more is seriously injured. [https://www.ktuu.com/content/news/Plane-off-runway-at-Unalaska-Airport-563346322.html (KTUU)]
*A double-decker bus carrying pilgrims crashes and catches fire near [[Medina]], [[Saudi Arabia]]. The disaster kills at least 35 foreigners. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-50081706 (BBC News)]
;Health and environment
*[[2019 outbreak of lung illness linked to vaping products]]
**[[Electronic cigarette]] maker [[Juul]] announces it will stop producing most of its flavored cartridges, excluding mint and menthol. [https://arstechnica.com/science/2019/10/juul-halts-sales-of-some-flavors-but-not-the-ones-teens-use-most/ (Arstechnica)]

;International relations
*[[Brexit negotiations]], [[Brexit]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] and the [[European Union]] agree on a new [[Brexit withdrawal agreement]] deal following talks in [[Brussels]]. [[First Johnson ministry|Current coalition]] partner the [[Democratic Unionist Party]] subsequently announces they will oppose the deal. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-50079385 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Murder of Kathleen Jo Henry]]
**Police in [[Anchorage, Alaska]] charge Brian Steven Smith, who was arrested on October 8 for the murder of Kathleen Jo Henry, with a second murder, that of Veronica Abouchuk. Smith reportedly confessed to killing Abouchuk and told authorities where her body could be found. [https://ktla.com/2019/10/17/man-seen-in-strangling-video-charged-in-killing-of-2nd-woman-in-alaska/ (KTLA Los Angeles)]
*The [[New York City Council]] votes to close [[Rikers Island]], [[New York City|the city]]'s main prison, by 2026. The complex's infrastructural deterioration and [[Rikers Island#Abuse and neglect of prisoners|excessive abuses]] were the cited reasons. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-new-york-rikers/new-york-city-council-votes-to-close-infamous-rikers-island-jails-idUSKBN1WW2ZW (Reuters)]
*The fourth night of violence in the streets of [[Catalonia]] in protest of the sentence of the Catalan independence leaders leaves 33 arrested and 80 injures. In [[Tarragona]], the main door of the city hall is burnt. [https://elpais.com/ccaa/2019/10/17/catalunya/1571348005_655263.html (''El País'')] [https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20191018/47104590938 (''La Vanguardia'')]

;Politics and elections
*Representative [[Elijah Cummings]], Maryland Democratic Congressman and [[United States House Committee on Oversight and Reform|House Oversight Committee]] Chair, dies at age 68. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/rep-elijah-cummings-house-oversight-committee-chair-dead/story?id=66338264 (ABC News)]
*[[List of Trump administration dismissals and resignations]]
**[[United States Secretary of Energy|U.S. Secretary of Energy]] [[Rick Perry]] announces he will resign by the end of the year. [https://www.npr.org/2019/10/17/593950148/energy-secretary-rick-perry-resigns (NPR)]
*[[Trial of Catalonia independence leaders]], [[2019 Catalan Protests]]
**The Catalan president [[Quim Torra]], in a special plenary session at the [[Parliament of Catalonia]], announces that he will convene a third independence referendum and a Constitution throughout the legislature. [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/politica/20191017/torra-autodeterminacion-govern-erc-jxcat-7686835 (''El Periódico'')]

;Science and technology
*[[National Aeronautic and Space Administration|NASA]] announces that the [[InSight]] Mars lander's heat probe had successfully dug {{convert|3|cm|in}} into the ground after becoming stuck {{Convert|35|cm|in}} in the ground in February 2019, confirming that the probe had not hit a rock and instead simply didn't have enough friction in the soil to dig much deeper. The vehicle landed near the Martian equator in November 2018. [https://www.space.com/mars-insight-lander-burrowing-probe-hope.html (Space.com)]
